utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I’m still curious—what are we reading next?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re picking the next read tonight at the neighborhood book club on Maple Street, and I can give you the shortlist if you want to catch up fast.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please — that’d help me catch up fast. What’s on the shortlist?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if I hear anything about the shortlist. Fingers crossed they go with something light and fun!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep everyone posted as soon as the shortlist is set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — just give me a holler when it’s set, and I’ll spread the word if I hear any whispers in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure — I’ll send a couple of short, easy options tonight. Hope your day’s been gentle.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Uli — that works for me. I’ll keep an eye on the napkins and we should be set for book club.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate that. I’ll send the options later tonight, and we can keep it nice and simple.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the exact time and place, and I’d appreciate a quick note on who’s bringing snacks too. That’ll make it much easier to plan my ride.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — it’s still at my place, and I’m confirming the exact time now. I’ll also sort out who’s bringing snacks and send you the details right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I appreciate it. Once you have the time and snacks sorted, please send it over so I can plan my ride.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late again — did Mara already send the book list? I’ll vote and can bring snacks if you still need them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet — we’re still waiting on the updated book list and meeting details. Snacks would be great, though.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll wait for Mara’s list and vote as soon as it comes in. I can bring snacks for tonight, too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’m still set for 7 pm, and The Midnight Library works for me after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right — I’m still a bit fuzzy, but I can check with Mara and send the latest book club details over. 7 pm and The Midnight Library sound noted.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren — that works for me. Just send the details when you can, and I’ll keep 7 pm clear after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — let’s keep it simple and set the next date before we leave.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’m in. Just send me the date and I’ll do my best to make it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do — I’ll send the date and place as soon as we set them, and I’ll bring the book list too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I may have missed the email—could you remind me of the title? Then I’ll make sure I’m on the right page.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No worries — I’ll drop off the book club details later, then we can sort out the plan.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — once you drop off the details, I’ll check the title and confirm the plan.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Leo — I don’t have any new book club updates yet, but I can check the next meeting spot and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal — that’d be great. Let me know when you find the spot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll check on the next meeting spot and update you as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still getting my bearings with the book club, so I’d like to hear what you think first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Definitely — we’re starting with "The Midnight Library," and I’ll send the time, place, and the rest of the reading list ahead of time so it’s easy to plan.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds helpful, thanks — I’ll watch for the details and give the book a try.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll remind everyone of the book club plan and we can sort out the details together.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — Mara’s sending the details, and I’d love everyone’s vote plus any snack ideas.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll pass along Mara’s details, get everyone’s vote, and see what snack ideas people have.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — book club. What are we reading this time, and when are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, do you know the book title and the day and time yet?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I missed that part — can you remind me the title and the day/time? I’m still in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the snacks and tea covered, and I’ll grab a few extra napkins too. I can send the book title and meeting time in a quick note if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d help, thanks. I’m still getting my bearings, so a quick note would be great.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll send the book title and meeting time over in a quick note. We should be all set for book club once I add those napkins.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send the time as soon as I have it. Thanks for being flexible!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the time when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’m checking on it now and I’ll send the time as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Next Thursday evening still works for me, and I can suggest a couple of lighter picks if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds great, Uli — Thursday evening at the cafe still works, and lighter picks would be perfect. Send me your suggestions, and I’ll share them with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll send over a couple of easy reads tonight. Thanks, Rosa — I’m glad Thursday at the cafe still works.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good, thanks, Quinn — 7 pm still works for me after pickup, and I’ve got The Midnight Library on my list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll send the invite and full details soon so you can plan around pickup. Looking forward to starting with The Midnight Library!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great — thanks. I’ll be ready by 7:30, and I’ll watch for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana — if the time and place are set, could you send them my way so I can plan my ride? I can also bring a simple snack unless that’s already covered.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the details — what time and place did Faye set for the book club? Once I confirm, I’ll send them along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t have the exact time and place yet either, so maybe we should wait for Faye’s confirmation. Once it’s set, I can plan my ride and bring a simple snack if needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing it together, but I think we were deciding the next book. Do you remember what title we landed on?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll double-check the latest carpool list and text you the pickup time once I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oops, I think I got my wires crossed — I meant the book club, not carpool. Do you remember the next book title?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club — I’m still a bit fuzzy, but I can check with Mara and resend the latest details once I have them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be great — thanks, Oren! I’ll keep my ears open too and share anything I hear about the shortlist.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess — I’ll check with Mara and send over the latest book club details as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds great, Leo — I’ll keep next Thursday at my place set and look out for your cozy mystery.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — I’ll send it over soon. Thanks, Mara!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: You’re welcome, Leo — I’ll keep it on the calendar and watch for your cozy mystery. See you next Thursday!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll remind everyone of the book club plan and circle back on the title and meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Vik — I’ll note that and wait for the title and meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep everyone posted on the title and meeting time, then we can sort out the rest together.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’m still waiting on Mara’s book list, and then I can vote and bring snacks. Once she sends the details, we can lock in the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are we still doing book club at your place this week? And once Mara sends the list, can you let me know the day and time?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Not at my place — Mara’s hosting next Thursday, and I’m still waiting on her list and the exact time. I’ll let you know as soon as she sends it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — let’s keep the dates and reading list set ahead of time. What book are we starting with?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a shortlist ready, and I think we should start with the one that sparked the most debate last time. If you want, I can lay out the options and we can pick tonight.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me — lay out the options and let’s pick tonight so we can lock in the next dates too.
